concepts.name: Proof V
concepts.description: A split V turns the familiar check into an ownable silhouette. The simplest bridge from Verity's current verification mark.
concepts.tradeoff: Clear and compact, but a check-derived V is a crowded visual territory.
concepts.alt: Ivory split V symbol beside a tall condensed VERITY wordmark on warm black.
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original logo exploration for Verity, an AI hardware engineering app that turns plain English into Verilog, simulates designs against a locked reference, optimizes chips, and proves equivalence. Brand: precise, engineering-led, confident, understated, laboratory instrument aesthetic. Create ONE refined original horizontal logo lockup, a bold memorable symbol at left and the word VERITY at right. Use warm ivory #F3EEE6 for all artwork, perfectly flat solid warm near-black #0A0806 background. Typography custom condensed sans serif uppercase, inspired by Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, heavy but sophisticated, optically kerned. Flat two-dimensional crisp vector-like silhouette, no mockup, no material texture, no shading, no glow, no gradients, no perspective. Spacious canvas, logo centered, artwork occupies roughly 75% width and 28% height. High-quality identity design, strong at small scale. Exact text: "VERITY". No other words, captions, labels, badges, watermarks, decorative linework or panels. No amber because brand reserves amber for verified results. Design a striking single compact V monogram with a subtle asymmetric checkmark reading inside its negative space. Two solid chamfered strokes with a shared angle language, the right stroke slightly taller. Abstract proof and precision without a generic checkbox or shield. The silhouette must be original, balanced and extremely simple. All edges pristine and flat, absolutely no distressing, dust, paper texture, stray pixels or grunge.

concepts.name: Silicon seal
concepts.description: A V cut into a silicon die makes the product's purpose immediate. Solid geometry gives it the character of a stamped instrument label.
concepts.tradeoff: The contacts will need a simpler version for a very small favicon.
concepts.alt: Ivory silicon die with side contacts and a V cutout, followed by the VERITY wordmark.

concepts.name: Logic pair
concepts.description: Two matching paths converge into a single V. The paired geometry points to comparing designs and checking that their behavior agrees.
concepts.tradeoff: The broad symbol and fine internal seams need refinement at small sizes.
concepts.alt: Two folded ivory logic paths forming a wide V next to the condensed VERITY wordmark.

concepts.name: Cut wordmark
concepts.description: The name carries the identity. A precise incision in the V introduces a technical detail without adding a separate emblem.
concepts.tradeoff: A standalone icon still needs to be developed for tabs and compact navigation.
concepts.alt: Custom heavy ivory VERITY lettering with an angular incision in the V on warm black.
